user.description: Afterwards you can add combined lists to the integration and use “Configure” for naming convention, controls and remembered categories. The Lovelace card “SmartLists” is available in your dashboards from now on.

naming.description: A character in front of a word turns it into a badge, e.g. “Milk @REWE” → store badge REWE. Characters stay in the item name. “—” turns a kind off.
